def is_product_even(numbers):
    # A product is even iff at least one factor is even.
    # An empty list gives a product of 1 (odd), so any() returns False, as it should.
    return any(n % 2 == 0 for n in numbers)


assert is_product_even([1, 2, 3])
assert not is_product_even([1, 3, 5])
assert not is_product_even([])
